---

## Flash & Portfolio Page Implementation Audit

### 1. Route Structure
- **`app/(app)/portfolio/`** — Single file, no layout/loading/error:
  - `page.tsx` — Server component (RLS-gated auth)
  - No dedicated client boundary structure
  - Suspense wraps gallery component

### 2. Current Page UI (`app/(app)/portfolio/page.tsx:67-92`)
- **Header:** "Flash & Portfolio" + "Studio portfolio gallery" description
- **CTA:** "Manage artists" button (Settings icon) → links to `/artists` (owner/admin only)
- **Gallery component:** `StudioPortfolioGallery` (client-side)
  - Filter chips: Artist selector + Style tag selector (both toggle-style, no "All" reset affordance)
  - Cards: 2x4 grid, aspect-square, image + hover overlay (artist name + caption)
  - Detail: Lightbox modal (backdrop blur, centered, image + meta + nav arrows)
  - Empty state: "No portfolio items yet" + "Go to artists" CTA

### 3. Database Schema
**`artist_portfolio_items` table** (migration `20260425100100_s20c_`):
- `id` (uuid PK), `studio_id`, `artist_id` (fk), `storage_path` (text)
- `caption` (nullable), `style_tag_ids` (uuid[]), `display_order` (int), `is_featured` (bool)
- `linked_booking_photo_id` (fk → booking_photos, nullable) — denotes promoted photo
- `created_by` (fk → auth.users), `created_at/updated_at`
- **Indexes:** artist+order, studio+featured, style_tags GIN
- **RLS:** Public SELECT (anon), INSERT/UPDATE/DELETE gated to studio_members (owner/admin/artist)
- **Storage bucket:** `artist-portfolio` (public read, 10MB max)

**`style_tags` table** (referenced):
- `id`, `studio_id`, `slug`, `name`, `color`, `icon`, `description`, `sort_order`

**`flash_events` table** (migration `20260422100000_flash_events`):
- `id`, `studio_id`, `artist_id`, `title`, `slug`, `description`, `event_date`, `start_time`, `end_time`
- `slot_duration_min`, `slot_price_cents`, `deposit_cents`, `currency`, `max_slots`
- `cover_image_url`, `flyer_url`, `location_id`, `public`, `status` (draft|published|completed|cancelled)
- **Related:** `flash_event_designs` (title, image_url, placement, price), `flash_event_slots` (auto-generated, reservation logic)

### 4. Related Routes
- **`app/(app)/flash-events/`** — Fully implemented:
  - `page.tsx` — list view w/ status filtering (upcoming/draft/published/completed/cancelled)
  - `[id]/` — detail with tabs (slots, designs, bookings)
  - `new/` — creation flow
  - **Not linked from portfolio page** — separate sidebar nav item

### 5. Public-facing Routes
- **`/book/[studioSlug]/artist/[artistSlug]/`** — Per-artist booking page (public, anon)
  - Fetches artist + portfolio via `GET /api/public/artists/[id]/portfolio`
  - Shows portfolio grid in sidebar (inferred from page code at line 73+)
- **`GET /api/public/artists/[id]/portfolio`** — Returns all items for artist (public read, RLS-permissioned)
- **No dedicated `/portfolio/[slug]` or `/p/[slug]`** — portfolio only at `/portfolio` (internal) + artist booking page

### 6. Sidebar Nav
**`components/app/sidebar/nav-config.ts:193-207`:**
- "Flash & Portfolio" → `/portfolio`, Image icon, roles: owner/admin/artist
- "Flash Events" → `/flash-events`, Zap icon, roles: owner/admin/artist/receptionist, studio plan required, studio_owner persona
- **Neither has child items** — both top-level nav items

### 7. Existing Reusable Patterns
- **Side panel:** `components/clients/ClientDialog.tsx` (Dialog + Sheet-like wrapper for detail views)
- **Drag-reorder:** `ArtistPortfolioManager` uses `@dnd-kit` (PointerSensor + SortableContext)
- **File upload:** Dialog with drag-drop zone + preview (lines 261-292 in `ArtistPortfolioManager`)
- **Style tag picker:** `components/shared/StyleTagPicker` (multi-select checkbox grid)
- **Promoted photos flow:** `ArtistPortfolioManager` has "From booking" dialog pulling from `booking-photos` bucket
- **No AI image-tag integration** — style tags are manual picker, no Claude API calls

### 8. Type Definitions
- `ArtistPortfolioItem` = `Database['public']['Tables']['artist_portfolio_items']['Row']` (lib/supabase/types.ts:7042)
- `FlashEvent`, `FlashEventDesign`, `FlashEventSlot` (line 7024–7036)
- `StyleTag` (line 7046)
- No `PortfolioSheet` or `FlashPiece` types

### 9. Tests
- **Zero portfolio tests** — messaging triage tests reference "share_portfolio" action but no page tests
- No E2E portfolio upload/reorder tests

### 10. Permissions/Role-gating
- **`/portfolio` page:** owner/admin/artist access (line 71: `canManage = ['owner', 'admin'].includes(auth.role)`)
- **"Manage artists" button:** owner/admin only
- **Upload/reorder:** Artist can edit own portfolio; admin/owner can edit any (app-layer, not RLS-enforced)
- **Public read:** All portfolio items readable by anon (RLS permits)

**Key insight:** Role checks are role-based, not per-artist — artists see own portfolio on `/artists/[id]` tab, not on `/portfolio` page.

---

**Summary:** Minimal MVP with gallery + artist manager tabs. No Flash Events connection on portfolio page. Public artist profiles show portfolio in booking flow. No AI, no complex filtering, no saved views. Drag-reorder + promote-from-booking already exist. Ready for major redesign without breaking dependencies.

# Sprint 13 — Flash & Portfolio Page · Full Rebuild

> Source: `InkOS_Flash_Portfolio_Page_Audit.pdf` (v1)
> Surface: `/portfolio` (authenticated) + `/p/[studioSlug]` + `/p/[studioSlug]/[artistSlug]` + `/p/[studioSlug]/flash/[pieceId]` (public)
> Status: Plan locked — Sprint 13. All 12 prior sprints complete.

---

## 1. Context — why this rebuild

Current `/portfolio` is a thin gallery: title + 1 grid + lightbox modal + 2 chip filters. The PDF audit identified that the page is doing **half a job**: it's a portfolio showcase, but InkOS needs a **dual-mode inventory + showcase system**.

**Two distinct jobs the page must do:**
1. **Flash mode** — sell pre-designed tattoo inventory (price, status, one-of-one, reserved → linked session).
2. **Portfolio mode** — showcase healed completed work (auto-pulled from Projects/sessions, photo progression Reference→Stencil→Fresh→Healed).

**Strategic stakes:** Flash inventory + healed-photo timeline + per-artist public profiles are net-new category-defining features. Closest competitors (Porter, Fresha, Booksy) ship neither. This is a moat-reinforcing build (#1 AI Design Assistant + #4 Transparent pricing both touch this surface).

**Decisions locked (confirmed with user 2026-04-28):**

| Decision | Choice | Reason |
|---|---|---|
| Payment rail | **Dodo Payments** | Project rule (CLAUDE.md §8). Stripe Connect forbidden. |
| Public surface | **Path on root domain `/p/[studio]/[artist]`** | Zero DNS work, Next 16 native routing. |
| Sheet model | **New `flash_sheets` table** | Sheets ≠ flash events. Inventory groupings vs scheduled walk-in days. |
| Scope | **Full PDF in Sprint 13** | Single migration, single PR, parallel agent build. |

---

## 2. Cuts (PDF Section 04)

Three deletions, no replacement:

1. **`Manage artists` button** in [app/(app)/portfolio/page.tsx:67-92](app/(app)/portfolio/page.tsx#L67-L92) — duplicate of `/artists` (sidebar item). Replace with `+ Upload` Onyx primary CTA.
2. **Single-card lightbox modal with Next→ pagination** in `StudioPortfolioGallery` component — replace with side-panel slide-in.
3. **`Studio portfolio gallery` subtitle** — too generic. Rewrite to *"Flash inventory, completed work, and public artist profiles."*

---

## 3. Schema — Dato (new migration)

-- 3.6 RPC — atomic reserve flash piece (called from Dodo webhook only)
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION reserve_flash_piece(
  p_piece_id   uuid,
  p_client_id  uuid,
  p_booking_id uuid
) RETURNS flash_pieces
LANGUAGE plpgsql SECURITY DEFINER AS $$
DECLARE result flash_pieces;
BEGIN
  UPDATE flash_pieces
     SET status = 'reserved',
         reserved_by_client_id = p_client_id,
         reserved_booking_id   = p_booking_id,
         reserved_at           = now()

     AND status = 'available'

  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'flash_piece_not_available' USING ERRCODE = 'P0001';
  END IF;
  PERFORM log_audit_action(result.studio_id, 'flash_piece.reserved',
                           jsonb_build_object('piece_id', p_piece_id));
  RETURN result;
END $$;

### 7.1 Dodo Payments — flash reserve flow

Reuse [lib/dodo/client.ts](lib/dodo/client.ts) — lazy-init.

1. Public client visits `/p/[studio]/flash/[pieceId]`, clicks **Reserve** → POST `/api/flash/[id]/reserve` with `{ clientEmail, clientName }`.
2. Route validates piece status = `available`, creates Dodo checkout:
   ```ts
   {
     return_url: `${SITE_URL}/p/[studio]/flash/[pieceId]?reserved=1`,
     metadata: { flash_piece_id: pieceId, studio_id, kind: 'flash_reserve' },
     customer: { email, name, billing: { country: 'US' } }, // ISO 3166
     amount: piece.deposit_cents,
     currency: piece.currency,

3. Returns `{ checkoutUrl }` — client redirects.
4. Webhook ([app/api/webhooks/dodo/route.ts](app/api/webhooks/dodo/route.ts)) verifies via `standardwebhooks` headers + `timingSafeEqual`. On `payment.succeeded` with `metadata.kind === 'flash_reserve'`:

## 7. Integrations

### 7.1 Dodo Payments — flash reserve flow

Reuse [lib/dodo/client.ts](lib/dodo/client.ts) — lazy-init.

1. Public client visits `/p/[studio]/flash/[pieceId]`, clicks **Reserve** → POST `/api/flash/[id]/reserve` with `{ clientEmail, clientName }`.
2. Route validates piece status = `available`, creates Dodo checkout:
   ```ts
   {
     return_url: `${SITE_URL}/p/[studio]/flash/[pieceId]?reserved=1`,
     metadata: { flash_piece_id: pieceId, studio_id, kind: 'flash_reserve' },
     customer: { email, name, billing: { country: 'US' } }, // ISO 3166
     amount: piece.deposit_cents,
     currency: piece.currency,
   }
   ```
3. Returns `{ checkoutUrl }` — client redirects.
4. Webhook ([app/api/webhooks/dodo/route.ts](app/api/webhooks/dodo/route.ts)) verifies via `standardwebhooks` headers + `timingSafeEqual`. On `payment.succeeded` with `metadata.kind === 'flash_reserve'`:
   - Look up or create `clients` row (email-keyed).
   - Create draft `bookings` row (status `pending_artist_review`, type `flash_reserve`).
   - Call `reserve_flash_piece(piece_id, client_id, booking_id)` RPC — atomic + audit.
   - Send Resend email: studio gets reservation alert, client gets confirmation w/ booking page link.
5. UI updates via Realtime subscription on `flash_pieces` channel.

**Constraints (CLAUDE.md §9 antipatterns):**
- `return_url` not `success_url`.
- Webhook ID + timestamp + signature headers.
- `customer.billing.country` ISO 3166 two-letter required.
